summary: A committee preparing a delegation has two messages with different recipients and dates.
realLife: The 31st District told eligible voters to expect the delegate voting email and said people who had filed to be delegates had already received a first-meeting notice.
inGame: needs: eligibility roll, candidate filings and meeting date.

turns.pulledBy: A member is both a voter and a candidate.
turns.writesBack: The member can vote and find the delegation meeting.

turns.pulledBy: A voting member never filed as a candidate.
turns.what: Staff explain why only the voting message arrived.
turns.writesBack: The separate notices no longer imply a missing nomination.
